$comment: This schema powers editor completion. Python performs cross-field and IANA timezone checks.
title: Databricks workflow monitoring configuration

default_timezone.description: Default IANA timezone for SLA deadlines.

workflows.description: Configured Databricks jobs. Only active entries are monitored.

job_id.description: Stable Databricks job ID polled by the collector.

monitoring_status.description: Include or exclude this job without deleting its configuration.

sla.description: Expected completion schedule for this workflow.

frequency.description: How often a successful workflow completion is expected.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone. Uses default_timezone when omitted.

first_deadline_date.description: First deadline in a repeating 14-day schedule.

day_of_month.description: Monthly deadline day. Short months use their final day.
